title: HTML Structure and the DOM - Quiz

questions.question: What is the purpose of web scraping?
options: To create new websites from scratch
To automatically extract specific data from websites
To design the visual layout of web pages
To execute JavaScript code in a browser
questions.explanation: Web scraping is the automated process of extracting specific data from websites, like product prices, news headlines, or contact information, without manual copying and pasting.

questions.question: In HTML, what is the difference between a tag and an attribute?
options: Tags define elements (like `<a>`); attributes provide extra information about the element (like `href`)
Tags are always visible; attributes are hidden
Attributes define elements (like `href`); tags provide extra information about the element (like `<a>`)
There is no difference; they are the same thing
questions.explanation: Tags (like `<a>`, `<div>`, `<h1>`) define the elements themselves. Attributes (like `href`, `class`, `id`) are added to tags to provide additional information or functionality.

questions.question: Why are `class` and `id` attributes important for web scraping?
options: They make the website load faster
They act like 'GPS coordinates' to help locate specific elements on a page
They are required for all HTML tags to work
questions.explanation: Classes and IDs are unique identifiers that help you pinpoint exact elements in a page. While many elements might share the same tag name (like 50 `<div>` tags), a specific `id` is usually unique, making it much easier to target the exact data you want.
